_purpose: SPEC-v0.2 P0 '固化 v0.2 schema'. The fingerprint of the v0.2 contract layer, so that a later edit to a field cannot be described as 'the same schema' and so that records from different generations are never pooled. Checked by tests/contract/test_v02_contracts.py::test_freeze_file_matches_the_code.

history.reason: P0 self-consistency pass: all_records_sha256 added, unrun-instance and unattributed-event gates added, dead re-exports removed
P1-b perception: ChangeRecord.modality documented as vlm | sensor | privileged | text so a state-change row can say which channel reported it (SPEC-v0.2 11 measures change detection per channel)
history.compatibility_delta: docstring only: no field, type, default or literal moved, so records_sha256 / all_records_sha256 / event_types_sha256 / ablation_registry_sha256 are all byte-identical to the previous freeze and only module_sha256 changed. A schema-4 record written before this re-freeze validates exactly as one written after it; the re-freeze exists because the fingerprint hashes module source, and an unrecorded source edit would make 'same schema' unfalsifiable.
